input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 applies New York law and Section 28.2 gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue objections — exactly the playbook preferred position. No arbitration provision appears anywhere in the document (search for "arbitration" returned nothing), so there is no foreign seat concern. The Section 28.3 pre-suit executive escalation is a fifteen-business-day meet-and-confer that expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings, and the carve-out in 28.2 permitting temporary injunctive relief elsewhere for confidential information or IP is mutual; neither affects the accepted law or forum. Compliant at the preferred position; no redline.
